## Document: CodX-Junior Watcher

### Overview

CodX-Junior Watcher is an event watcher engine specifically designed to detect changes across various sources, such as files. It is engineered to register and notify different types of events, highlighting when a file has been changed.

### ProjectFileWatcher

The `ProjectFileWatcher` component within CodX-Junior is tasked with monitoring and identifying changes within valid project files, ensuring any alterations are promptly detected and reported. 

This system serves as a vital tool for developers needing to track file modifications in real-time, facilitating efficient monitoring and management of project file integrity and updates.
